biotools.summary: Pan.bio is a cloud genomics platform for pipeline execution, exploratory analysis, and clinical variant interpretation. Workflows runs validated Nextflow and nf-core pipelines including Sarek, rnaseq, scrnaseq, mag, ampliseq, chipseq and atacseq without local installation. Notebooks provides Python and R sessions with a preinstalled bioinformatics stack, importing public data from GEO, SRA and IPG by accession and reading Workflows outputs directly. VAIC applies ACMG/AMP variant classification with gene-specific rule sets from CanVIG-UK and ClinGen ENIGMA, with automated evidence criteria implemented for BRCA1 and BRCA2. Cohorts provides federated analysis of patient data within a Trusted Research Environment.
